:PROPERTIES:
:foo: bar
:foo+: baz
:cat: dog
:END:

# Even though these are inheriting the properties and overwriting and/or appending to them, this is not represented in the parser AST so Organic does not do any special handling of this.

* Overwrite
:PROPERTIES:
:foo:      lorem
:bat:      car
:END:

* Append
:PROPERTIES:
:foo+:      ipsum
:cake:      lie
:END:
